import http.client, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
sha="f874831fe157cdc979cb8b8de9e033ae6bf9128c"
def ck(label,ok):
 print(label+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
key=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def get(path):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  c.request("GET",path,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+key})
  r=c.getresponse();return r.status,r.read(150000)
 finally:c.close()
head=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
ck("SOURCE_SHA",head==sha)
status,body=get("/healthz")
ck("LIVE_SHA",status==200 and json.loads(body).get("commit")==sha)
status,body=get("/oauth/status")
ck("PRIVATE_OWNER_ACCOUNT",status==200 and isinstance(json.loads(body),dict))
status,body=get("/drafts")
ck("PRIVATE_DRAFTS",status==200 and isinstance(json.loads(body).get("drafts"),list))
for suite in ("test_assistant.py","test_publisher_runtime.py","test_drafts.py","test_media_fallback.py","test_library.py"):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",suite,"-q"],
    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=45)
 ck("GSERVER_OFFLINE_"+suite,p.returncode==0)
print("REAL_PROVIDER_CALLS=ZERO")
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
PY
